config.email.empty: No email accounts configured. Add one!
config.email.id_help: Unique identifier (e.g. personal, work). Lowercase, hyphens allowed.
config.email.keep_password: Leave empty to keep the existing password.
config.email.id_exists: An account with this ID already exists.
config.email.host_required: Provide at least an IMAP or SMTP host.
config.email.account_enabled_help: If disabled, the agent cannot use this account.
config.email.allow_sending_help: If disabled, the agent can only read emails, not send them.
help.email.relay_cheatsheet_id: Optional cheatsheet appended as instructions when the inbox watcher forwards new mail to the agent.
config.email.load_failed_disabled: Adding, editing and deleting is disabled until the list has loaded.
config.email.name_help: Display name of the account in AuraGo, such as "Personal" or "Work".
config.email.imap_host_help: Address of your mail provider's incoming mail server (IMAP).
config.email.smtp_host_help: Address of your mail provider's outgoing mail server (SMTP).
config.email.username_help: User name for IMAP and SMTP, usually the full email address.
config.email.password_help: Password or app password of the account. It is stored encrypted in the vault.
config.email.watch_enabled_help: AuraGo regularly checks the folder chosen below for new mail and can react to it.
config.email.watch_folder_help: IMAP folder that is watched for new mail. The default is INBOX.
config.email.interval_seconds_help: How often the folder is checked, in seconds (default 120). Shorter intervals put more load on the mail server.
